notes: Delivered file icon.png is actually an AVIF container (ftyp header), 384x384 web render (converted via sips). Squircle mask + pale field + gloss + drop-shadow are all baked into the bitmap; corners opaque near-white, not transparent. Full-bleed 1024 master and authored Icon-Composer variant layers NOT seen — mask/gloss/shadow are the site render, not verified ship layers. Chrome-arm hexes region-averaged from thin strokes -> (estimated). The embossed C is a logo mark (MacPaw broom), counted as a monogram not text, so #12 passes. Strong palette coherence with cover (same icon on pink/lavender floral scene). Score 11/12: the one hard miss is #10 (not Liquid-Glass-ready), which is honest given the Big Sur era classification.
